task.title: Signing up for a Quay.io plan
task.shortdesc: To subscribe to a paid Quay.io plan, you can select a tier on the Pricing page and complete checkout with Stripe. A valid credit card is required.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Quay.io Pricing page.
Decide on a plan, for example, Small, and click Buy Now. You are redirected to the Create New Organization page. Enter the following information:

ul.li: Optional. You can select a different plan if you want a plan larger than, for example, Small.

step.cmd: Resolve the captcha, and select Create Organization.
You are redirected to Stripe. Enter the following information:

ul.li: Card information, including MM/YY and the CVC
Check the box if you want your information to be saved.

step.cmd: Click Subscribe after all boxes have been filled.
